content.text:
A003 — Snake
{v.boardText}
Arrows move   Enter restart
B back

scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.gridWidth = 12
v.gridHeight = 12
v.snake = {{x=5, y=5}, {x=5, y=6}, {x=5, y=7}}
v.dirX = 0
v.dirY = -1
v.targetX = 2
v.targetY = 2
v.stepTime = 0.5
v.lost = false
v.boardText = ""
local function draw()
    local text = ""
    if v.lost then text = "GAME OVER\n" end
    for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
        for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
            local char = "."
            if x == v.targetX and y == v.targetY then
                char = "*"
            else
                for _, part in ipairs(v.snake) do
                    if part.x == x and part.y == y then
                        char = "O"
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            text = text .. char
        end
        text = text .. "\n"
    end
    v.boardText = text
end
draw()
scripts.update:
local v = ctx.v
if v.lost then return end
local head = v.snake[1]
local nx = head.x + v.dirX
local ny = head.y + v.dirY

if nx < 0 or nx >= v.gridWidth or ny < 0 or ny >= v.gridHeight then
    v.lost = true
end

for _, part in ipairs(v.snake) do
    if part.x == nx and part.y == ny then
        v.lost = true
    end
end

if not v.lost then
    table.insert(v.snake, 1, {x=nx, y=ny})
    if nx == v.targetX and ny == v.targetY then
        -- pseudo-random for now
        v.targetX = (nx + 5) % v.gridWidth
        v.targetY = (ny + 7) % v.gridHeight
        v.stepTime = math.max(0.1, v.stepTime * 0.95)
    else
        table.remove(v.snake)
    end
end

local text = ""
if v.lost then text = "GAME OVER\n" end
for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
    for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
        local char = "."
        if x == v.targetX and y == v.targetY then
            char = "*"
        else
            for _, part in ipairs(v.snake) do
                if part.x == x and part.y == y then
                    char = "O"
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        text = text .. char
    end
    text = text .. "\n"
end
v.boardText = text
scripts.input_up: local v = ctx.v; if v.dirY == 0 then v.dirX = 0; v.dirY = -1 end
scripts.input_down: local v = ctx.v; if v.dirY == 0 then v.dirX = 0; v.dirY = 1 end
scripts.input_left: local v = ctx.v; if v.dirX == 0 then v.dirX = -1; v.dirY = 0 end
scripts.input_right: local v = ctx.v; if v.dirX == 0 then v.dirX = 1; v.dirY = 0 end
